confidence_notes: Beer, coffee, lunch and three-course dinner rest on 2026-dated Vang Vieng cost aggregates from web search. They are indicative and not menu-checked, and beer comes from a single listing. Cocktail rests on a rough Vang Vieng bar range and sits about three times the beer anchor. No Vang Vieng wine price was found, so wine_glass uses a judgment-based relationship of about 3.5 times the beer anchor and is the least supported food or drink figure. Accommodation anchors are holistic general-knowledge estimates, not checked against live listings or booking pages, and carry the widest uncertainty. July is generally low season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Vang Vieng-specific 2026 aggregates were used directly where found. Laos-wide and Vientiane averages served only as cross-checks, and Vientiane nightlife benchmarks were treated as upper references because they reflect urban, upscale bars. Accommodation has no searched comparable and rests on general knowledge of small Laos backpacker towns.
